headline: Netanyahu's Secret Abu Dhabi Visit Amid Iran's 'Doomsday War' Threat
subheadline: IDF extends small attack drone ban after lethal FPV crash killed two sergeants, while Saudi flights divert 160 km due to suspected drone/missile threats.
lede: Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu made an unannounced secret visit to Abu Dhabi to meet UAE President Mohamed bin Zayed as Iran's foreign minister declared readiness for a "doomsday war" against US aggression. The IDF extended its ban on small attack drones after an FPV drone crash in northern Gaza killed Master Sgt. Nadav Kali and Master Sgt. Ofek Moalem, while Saudi airspace disruptions forced civilian aircraft to avoid Riyadh by 160 km and hold for 30 minutes due to suspected drone/missile threats. In Ukraine, Russian forces launched coordinated drone and missile strikes across Kyiv, Dnipro, and Odesa, damaging infrastructure in Kharkiv and Vinnytsia and injuring one person when a drone struck a residential building in Kyiv's Darnytskyi district. Ukrainian drones delivered humanitarian aid to residents in occupied Oleshky in Kherson Oblast, dropping supplies at 100 locations overnight.

sections.title: Russian Strikes Hammer Ukrainian Cities Across Front
sections.body: Russian forces launched coordinated drone and missile strikes across Kyiv, Dnipro, and Odesa, with explosions reported near Fastiv and damage to infrastructure in Kharkiv and Vinnytsia. Ukrainian air defenses intercepted several projectiles while a Russian drone struck a residential building in Kyiv's Darnytskyi district, injuring one person. A Russian missile struck a logistics center in Odesa used by Nova Poshta for storing military cargo, according to the Russian Defense Ministry. Ukrainian drones delivered humanitarian aid to residents in occupied Oleshky in Kherson Oblast, dropping supplies at 100 locations overnight.

sections.title: Covert Abu Dhabi Visit Amid Escalation
sections.body: Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu made an unannounced, highly secretive visit to Abu Dhabi to meet UAE President Mohamed bin Zayed. Iran's Foreign Minister Araghchi declared readiness for a "doomsday war" and said Iran will stand firm against US aggression. The IDF extended its ban on small attack drones after an FPV drone crash in northern Gaza killed Master Sgt. Nadav Kali and Master Sgt. Ofek Moalem. Defense Minister Katz ordered a general closure on the West Bank, barring Palestinian laborers from settlements during Sukkot except essential workers; explosions were reported in Erbil and Koya, Iraq, and Saudi airspace disruptions forced civilian aircraft to avoid Riyadh by 160 km and hold for 30 minutes due to suspected drone/missile threats.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: Saudi airspace disruptions, explosions in Erbil and Koya, and the IDF drone ban extension point to expanding aerial threats and operational vulnerabilities. Netanyahu's covert Abu Dhabi visit coincides with Iran's explicit "doomsday war" declaration, suggesting Israel is securing Gulf backing for potential escalation against Iran. Russian coordinated drone and missile strikes across Kyiv, Dnipro, Odesa, Kharkiv, and Vinnytsia demonstrate sustained offensive capability to target infrastructure and civilian areas.
